system.description: Speak the terms of a curse, best your victim in a Mental Challenge, and expend Mental Traits to empower it. A basic curse (lasting one scene, granting one Negative Trait of your choice) costs no Mental Traits. Each additional Mental Trait spent extends the duration by two sessions or adds another Negative Trait or a point of Flaw. Only Dominate or Vicissitude of equal or greater level than the Baali's Daimoinon can undo the curse.
